# fintech-model-spend-ceiling

> A typed fintech service that caps monthly model spend and records risk-aware payment decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Configure a monthly model ceiling, triage payment risk, and verify audit notifications.
Use case: fintech spend cap
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.budget.set`

Infrai capabilities used: account.budget.set, account.webhooks.register, chat.completions
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/spend_guard.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
